_comment: Per lab (design/LAB1.md 10.6): attempt1_due is 23:59:59 Europe/Warsaw on the Sunday after the session and is advisory (a receipt after it is recorded as after_attempt1_due: true and still counts); corrections_due is 08:00:00 on the Saturday of the next session (Lab 8: Saturday 30 January 2027, two weeks after the last session) and a receipt after it is late: true, which the grader marks counts: false. Naive timestamps are local time in `timezone`; an explicit offset is accepted too. tests/test_receipt.py checks the weekdays, the hours and the ordering of these instants.
